editorial:
Imagine finding out you are having a baby right after you finally finished a messy divorce. That is exactly the chaos you get with this movie. You will meet a couple who absolutely cannot stand each other, but they are suddenly forced back into each other's lives because of the pregnancy. It is a lighthearted look at how a little baby can make two grown adults rethink their entire lives. The vibe is very cozy and funny, making it feel like a classic Sunday afternoon watch where you just want to see if these two can stop fighting long enough to be parents.

What really makes this work is the snappy dialogue and the chemistry between the leads. The pacing moves quickly, and the jokes land well even by today's standards. While some of the plot points feel a bit old-fashioned, the heart of the story is still relatable. If you enjoy old-school romantic comedies, you should definitely check this one out. Since it is an older film, you might want to look for a high-quality digital restoration.
endingExplained: After spending the whole movie arguing and trying to figure out their new lives, the couple realizes they actually still love each other. The stress of the pregnancy helps them see that their divorce was a mistake. In the end, they decide to get back together and start their family as a team. They put their pride aside, forgive each other for the past, and happily welcome the baby into a loving home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic romantic comedies and feel-good stories.
